_doc: How people weigh an errand before they commit to it, and again while it lasts (weigh.gd, docs/weigh.md). Cost: the time out there (the walk there, `work` seconds at it, the walk back to the nearest fire; straight-line distances count `detour` times). Risk: the health that time costs in a cold that can kill (by day, and by night once the trip runs into the dark; an announced weather from when it comes), counted `safety` times over; nothing is weighed for the cold while it can't kill within `horizon` seconds. An errand fits when it leaves at least `floor` of the person's health. `traits` scale the floor (cautious people keep more in hand); `need`: while a store holds less than `per_head` a head, people keep `mult` less in hand for it (hunger drives them further). While out in a deadly cold, someone heads back to the nearest fire as soon as what they have above `back_floor` only just covers the way there (counted `safety` times), checked every `check_every` seconds. Gathering weighs its node again every `recheck` seconds. While the river is in flood nobody goes across it or into it: errands there don't fit, and walkers wait on the bank (a popup at most every `flood_say_every` s). `beasts`: places within `reach` of a hunting beast or a known den count `penalty` more in the choice of where to work (as if that much further); within `avoid_reach` of a hunting beast with band tactics (hunt.json kinds) nobody goes, and nobody runs there to tend someone hurt. `refuse`: per reason (cold, flood, beast) the person's activity while refusing (`act`), the popup, the life.json talk situation they speak in (`talk_as`), and the `reason` an envoy or a trader can't be sent (rivals.envoy_block, folk.trade_block).
